summary: editable-contracts preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The npm package editable-contracts declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, marks it executable, and uses it to invoke a sibling file `math_init.js` bundled in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line JavaScript file protected with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (array `n7gIxM`, shift routine `WV8StW`) and char-code reconstruction; its filename and content have no relation to the package's stated purpose (JSON editable contracts). The installer script `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-identifier variable names (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x19328d`) and per-function string tables, hiding the runtime-download and payload-invocation logic. Downloading an alternate language runtime at install time to execute a bundled, purpose-unrelated obfuscated blob under a JavaScript engine that Node-based inspection would not evaluate is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
